headline_summary: Sample edition: every company and story below is invented, so you can review the design without spending anything on the API.

stories.title: Sample Robotics raises a $120M Series C to take warehouse automation to mid-size retailers
stories.summary: The invented company says the round will fund a move from large fulfilment centres to smaller regional warehouses, with deployments priced per pick instead of as upfront hardware.
stories.why_it_matters: A usage-based pricing model could open robotics to customers that could never justify the capital cost.

stories.title: Placeholder Health acquires a two-year-old clinical notes startup for an undisclosed sum
stories.summary: The deal folds a twelve-person team into the larger company's scheduling product, one of several small acquisitions in the category this quarter.
stories.why_it_matters: Incumbents are buying AI features rather than building them, which shortens the exit window for point solutions.

stories.title: Demo Ledger opens its bookkeeping API to third-party developers
stories.summary: Developers can now read and post transactions directly, and the company is sharing revenue with the first fifty partners who build on the API.
stories.why_it_matters: It's an early sign of fintech infrastructure moving from closed products to platforms.

stories.title: Seed valuations hold steady while time between rounds keeps growing, a fictional report finds
stories.summary: The made-up survey shows median seed prices flat year over year, but the gap between seed and Series A has stretched by several months.
stories.why_it_matters: Founders may need to plan for more runway than the last cycle's playbook suggests.
